title: Bringing history into the present
summary: Microsoft chose LemonSlice to power an AI Theodore Roosevelt avatar at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library.
body_markdown:
“Talk with TR” initially used a different avatar provider but the teams did not like how it looked or felt. “It looked like a videogame,” said Matt Briney, Chief Communications Officer of the TRPL. “It didn't feel like you were talking to Theodore Roosevelt.” Ultimately, Microsoft evaluated LemonSlice and thought, “Well that's really promising. It looks like you're actually talking to a human being” continued Matt. Plus, the avatar could be powered off a real historical photograph of Roosevelt.


The Microsoft team liked how realistic and dynamic the LemonSlice avatar was. The natural hand gestures and whole body motions were unique to LemonSlice's offering and important for making AI TR feel alive.


Brad Smith at Microsoft reflected, “We at Microsoft were so pleased and so impressed not just by what you created \[...\] but how easy it was for all of us to work together.”
